title: Epic Fantasy Landscapes: Floating Islands Tutorial
description: How MJ v6.1 nails epic fantasy scenes 鈥?floating islands, magical forests, glowing lakes.

prompt.main: epic fantasy landscape, three floating islands suspended above a glowing misty forest, waterfalls cascading from each island into the void below, ancient runes carved into the rocks, bioluminescent plants glowing blue and purple, ancient ruined temple on the largest island, dramatic golden hour sunlight breaking through storm clouds, hyper detailed, 8k, unreal engine 5, dnd concept art --v 6.1 --ar 21:9 --s 850

explained.why: Very high stylize suits epic fantasy scenes.
Anchoring to D&D concept art gives MJ a high-quality reference frame.

tutorial.intro: Fantasy landscapes need layered skies + subject + ground + a concept-art anchor.
steps: Sky layer: dramatic golden hour sunlight breaking through storm clouds 鈥?light + dramatic sky.
Subject layer: three floating islands suspended above a glowing misty forest 鈥?multiple islands + quantity + relationship.
Motion layer: waterfalls cascading from each island into the void below 鈥?dynamic element.
Detail layer: ancient runes carved into the rocks, bioluminescent plants 鈥?micro details.
Story layer: ancient ruined temple on the largest island 鈥?one building adds narrative.
Style anchor: dnd concept art + unreal engine 5 鈥?anchor to game concept art + a renderer.
tutorial.tips: "floating islands" alone feels flat. Add "three floating islands" + "cascading waterfalls" + "ancient temple" 鈥?the trio gives MJ the "epic" feel.

faq.q: My fantasy scene feels too "busy" 鈥?what to do?
faq.a: Cut half the elements. Less is more. Focus on 1 main subject + 1 story point.

faq.q: How to make floating islands feel "floating"?
faq.a: Add "waterfalls cascading into the void below" 鈥?waterfalls disappearing into nothingness below sells the floating feeling instantly.
MJ is fast + good composition. SD + Dreamshaper is more diverse. Flux is the most stable.
